description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the ThingsAggregator component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods to retrieve timeout and parallelism parameters, as well as an enumeration of known configuration values with default settings.

classes.name: ThingsAggregatorConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for the Things Aggregator in the Eclipse Ditto services.

methods.name: getSingleRetrieveThingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the ThingsAggregatorActor to wait for retrieving a single thing.

methods.name: getMaxParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of retrieve commands that can be in flight simultaneously.
